Thanks Ben — quick read and initial legal comments below.

High level: the structure is ok but we should tighten the audit trigger, evidence definition, and limit our exposure on third‑party reseller warranties.

Redline summary (see attached redlines_legal.docx):
- Audit window: suggest 18 months instead of 24. That reduces long-tail exposure and aligns with our retention limits.
- Evidence definition: define a closed list (invoice, proof of payment, PO, reseller confirmation email) and require a single point of contact for audits. Avoid open-ended language like "any documents reasonably requested."
- Escrow/holdback language: their draft suggests a 60‑day holdback. If holdback is needed, cap at 30 days and require monthly reconciliations.
- Indemnity carveouts: remove joint-and-several phrasing for pass-through claims; propose limited liability back to the reseller.
- Confidentiality: ensure confidentiality exception for evidence used solely for audit and returned/destroyed after review.

Ops note for Olga: we'll need a template evidence packet. Please draft a checklist with sample files we can hand off. Marissa — please prepare a short note to CloudPilot highlighting any operational constraints on producing signed reseller confirmations within 7 days.

I'll incorporate the redlines into a clean mark-up and send back before EOD.

—Karthik

Forwarding our internal read and proposed legal redlines. We want to confirm two operational points before you sign: 1) the evidence packet contents; and 2) the audit timeframe.

What we propose (subject to your review):
